{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The terraces ripple like green waves, and the light loves them."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The spring water is cold enough to wake your toes and your spirit."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A tangle of stalls where the haggling is half the fun."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Monkeys, mossy temples and a walk that feels older than the island itself."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A green ridge with air like a cool drink and views that make you forget your feet."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Terima kasih (thank you) for a lunch that treats vegetables like the main event."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lotus ponds and carved stone, quiet enough to hear the water think."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A breezy pause with drinks that taste like someone actually cared."}]}
Sunset ease, temple green, rice and springs, then a sea-temple goodbye — every must-do tucked in, terima kasih (thank you).
